senses.gloss: c. ch. = h. or <cite ref="H00994"><he>חָלוּט</he></cite> (v. <cite ref="H01020"><he>חָלַט</he> I</cite>).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 6:1:3">Y. Ned. VI, beg. 39ᶜ</cite>; Y. Naz. V, 55ᶜ top.
Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ bot. חֲלִיטָן their (the Samaritans’) ḥalut.—Pl. (fem.) חֲלִיטָתָא; (masc.) חֲלִיטִין.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 13:6">Targ. II Sam. XIII, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 13:8">8</cite>.—
Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᵈ ח׳ דשוק ḥ. sold in the market (mixed with oil), v. אִסְקְרִיטִין.—
Ib. (expl. חלת מסרת) ח׳ דמיי water-ḥ. (for which Pes. 37ᵇ חלוט של בעלי בתים).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 3:1:8">Y. Erub. III, 20ᵈ</cite> <he>אכל חליטן</he> (read: <he>חליטין</he> or <cite ref="H01036"><he>חליטא</he></cite>); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94">Gen. R. s. 94</cite>, beg. <cite ref="H00995"><he>חֲלוּטִין</he></cite> (Ar. <he>אְלִיטִין</he>, dial. for <he>הֲ׳</he>).
